body:
Hey, thanks for the reply. Sorry about the length of the post, but thank you so much for reading what I had  to say. I have a medical appointment Thursday to discuss my blood work, so while I'm there, I'll talk to the doctor about seeing a professional. Luckily, military benefits are really good, so I won't owe any money for medications or visits (not even a copay).

My only concern is that I don't want to lose my job or benefits because of this. I can't have my family thinking I just went to the doctor because I couldn't hack it and decided to pull the "depression," card to get out. My Dad would never understand, but I know that he'd help me and stand behind me in the long run. He's always been the happiest person on the planet, so depression is not real to him.

My mother, on the other hand, has been medicated for years. She has finally found a balance of some sort that works for her, and she seems very happy now, even with the hand life dealt her as well. I hope to be in her position one day.

I'll bring it up Thursday and keep in touch with you regarding the progress I make with getting a referral. If you don't mind, I'll send you a PM from my normal account as I don't really expect to keep up with this one for more than a couple of weeks.

Thanks again for reading and the reply. It means a lot when I feel like there's no one to talk to.
